title: Frank Fooks Memorial Park & Campground

services.name: Acme Campground
services.desc: Located on the South end of Acme is the Frank Fooks Memorial Park Campground. It is a well treed campground, including 14 (30 AMP) power/water stalls and on-site campground management. Within a short walking distance, there is a washroom and shower
